subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary Punctuality means keeping to the appointed hour. Time is the most valuable thing in our life. No portion of this valuable thing should be wasted. So we should make the best use of time. An unpunctual man cannot perform his duty properly. He is harmful both for himself and others. In Military fields a few minutes loss mean the loss of a battle and it may change the destiny of a nation. Want of punctuality reveals want of culture and it is discourteous. So, one should maintain punctuality at any cost. In this respect the western people are more punctual than we.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Nawab Faijunnesa Govt. Girls' High School, Comilla. Sl. No. 28; Page No. 77
